title: I'm not a fan
text:
I'm not a fan. It's my first time using these bags, I looked Into them for several weeks and ordered them due to great reviews. I didn't pay attention when I finally ordered, these do not have the screen flap. I was surprised that the soil stayed in when I did check for growth.

However I had the hardest time trying to find a balance of moisture. I tried everything, even moving them, but couldn't seem to get it right. Ive grown beautiful gardens for 30 years, and everything always does great.
In the bags I started potatoes, carrots and radishes, things I've grown Easily and heartily for many many years in the ground I never had a problem.
As I've gotten older I've tried to use more pots and planters instead of trying to build an elevated garden area, and I've grown everything with no problems, except for the bags this year. It's a shame, I really was looking forward to using these.

My gardens are year round, with a few seasonal things. I live in tried digits in summer and beautiful sunny Winters. And like I said for 30 years, I have fruit and citrus trees, every herb imaginable, every fruit and vegetable you can think of. Even "hard to grow " things I have.

I am blessed to be able to walk outside and pick everything fresh for meals. There's always plenty to share with neighbors and family, and I dry over abundance herbs and some fruits. I use some dried fruits for bath and beauty products that I make.

Anyway the point is I know how to grow things lol. Just not in these bags
